content.short: QuestN is a Web3 quest and airdrop campaign platform that helps projects grow communities with AI-supported tasks.
content.description: QuestN is a Web3 growth platform for quests, airdrops, and campaign automation. Projects can launch task-based campaigns, verify social and on-chain activity, segment users through eligibility rules, and distribute rewards to communities. The platform positions itself around AI-powered airdrop optimization and provides templates for social tasks, NFT-holder campaigns, testnet missions, and gaming or DeFi engagement. For Mantle teams, QuestN can be used to onboard users, run ecosystem campaigns, and measure participation across wallet and community actions.
content.meta: QuestN helps Web3 projects run quests, airdrops, and growth campaigns. Discover QuestN on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
